title: Get to know Purchases
summary: Tour of Purchase Quotes, Purchase Invoices, Purchase Payments, Providers and Provider Products and Services: what each screen is for.

steps.title: Purchases
steps.details: This section has 5 screens; we'll go through them one by one.

steps.title: Purchase Quotes
steps.details: A provider's quote: which products or services, at what price. Once confirmed, it's invoiced when received. It has 9 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Purchase Invoices
steps.details: What the clinic owes a provider: it comes from a purchase quote or is entered/imported directly. It has 9 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Purchase Payments
steps.details: What the clinic pays providers: payments of purchase invoices and advances. It has 5 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Providers
steps.details: Contact details, terms and products of each provider. It has 13 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Menu → Purchases → Provider Products and Services
Provider Products and Services
steps.details: Catalog of what is bought from each provider, with its price, to build purchase quotes and invoices. It has 4 guides in «Guide me on this screen».
